messages.subject: trouble to installing BioGeoBEARS
parts:
Hello everyone,

I updated R in my computer and now, I has a problem to installing BioGeoBEARS. I tried to install from CRAN and then, install it from GitHub and did not work. Everytime appear this error: Warning in install.packages: package ‘BioGeoBEARS’ is not available (for R version 3.6.0). Also, I changed the mirror to install packages and nothing. Somebody could help me please?

Thank you!

messages.author: 3506758dd75c28c2
messages.subject: Re: trouble to installing BioGeoBEARS
parts:
Hi, Cássia - 

Did you figure this out? Nick helped me via email. If you install the dependencies first it should work. 

install.packages("rexpokit")
install.packages("cladoRcpp")

Then pull directly from github & set dependencies to false, if you don't do this it will get hung up trying to pull them and then you'll get that same warning. 

devtools::install_github(repo="nmatzke/BioGeoBEARS", dependencies=FALSE)

Hope that helps, 
Jen
